task.question: Who won Best Pop Duo/Group Performance at the 2026 Grammy Awards?
task.evidence: Best Pop Duo/Group Performance | Cynthia Erivo, Ariana Grande | Defying Gravity

answer:
Ariana Grande and Cynthia Erivo won Best Pop Duo/Group Performance at the 2026 Grammy Awards for their rendition of “Defying Gravity,” from Wicked. 

FINAL: Ariana Grande and Cynthia Erivo
